nodes.label: Black Knight Reference Sprite Sheet
nodes.description: Third-party asset-pack sprite sheet sampled as visual reference for the Thaira browser RPG. Layout: 4 rows x 6 columns on a solid black background. Row 1 = front-facing idle/walk cycle, row 2 = back-facing walk with flowing cape, row 3 = side-facing (left) walk, row 4 = action/attack poses (overhead sword raise, wide slash arc with motion trail, forward thrust, guard stance). Character archetype: heavy-armored melee knight in blackened plate with red trim, sword and heater shield bearing a red rampant lion. Art style: high-detail 2.5D pre-rendered pixel art, glossy metallic shading, strong rim light, top-down-ish 3/4 view.
nodes.rationale: Kept in tools/amostra as style/layout reference for how a full 4-direction character sheet is organized, not as a shipped game asset.

nodes.label: Black Knight Archetype (dark plate melee)
nodes.description: Sword-and-shield melee archetype rendered as an evil/elite palette variant of the standard knight: black armor, red heraldry, red-lined cape.

nodes.label: Reference Material, Not Shipped Assets
nodes.description: Everything under tools/amostra ('amostra' = sample) is a sampled frame grab from third-party commercial asset packs, held as style and layout reference while building Thaira.
nodes.rationale: These sheets live under tools/ rather than assets/ precisely because they are not licensed-for-ship game content; they define the target look (frame count per animation, direction rows, proportions, outline treatment) that the project's own art must match.
